scope: Claims used in this campaign. Literature statements distinguish full-text reads from abstract-only access; local profile calculations are not posterior reproductions.

claims.statement: The released compressed DESI DR2 BAO vector constrains distances relative to the drag sound horizon. A BAO-only background fit without an early-time ruler calibration does not identify H0 separately.

primary_evidence.locator: Printed pp. 4-5, Eqs. (1)-(5), and Sec. VII, pp. 23-25.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: An explicit early-universe ruler model or calibration can constrain rd and then H0; that adds assumptions and/or data not present in this BAO-only screen.
claims.experiment_implication: Retain alpha=c/(H0 rd) as a free amplitude and report profile fits as screening calculations, not H0 measurements.

claims.statement: The campaign's flat late-time LCDM, constant-w and CPL fits are correlated-Gaussian profile minima over stated bounds; they do not reproduce DESI collaboration posterior constraints or Bayesian evidence.
claims.status: local numerical method reproduced; interpretation bounded by paper

primary_evidence.locator: Results II, Sec. VII and Table VI; collaboration model and CMB/SN likelihood combinations.
Table I prior ranges and Secs. II-III model/likelihood conventions.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The numerical minima are reproducible for the pinned 13-point vector, but the screen omits radiation/curvature/perturbations and does not sample a posterior.
claims.experiment_implication: Do not translate local Delta-chi-square values into sigma, odds, calibrated probabilities or collaboration posterior intervals.

claims.statement: Published preferences for evolving dark energy vary with likelihood, data branch, prior and statistic; reanalyses of the same released observations are not independent survey confirmations.
claims.status: full-text-supported by collaboration and alternative reanalyses; inputs overlap

primary_evidence.locator: Table VI, p. 24; conditional profile Delta-chi-square comparisons for stated data combinations.
Tables 10-11, Sec. 7; updated calibration and model-comparison metrics.
Full arXiv HTML read, v8; alternative inference over overlapping BAO/SN inputs.
Full arXiv HTML read, v2; alternative directional interpretation of the same BAO information.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The cited analyses use differing likelihoods, data branches and priors; no average of their nominal significances is valid, and this campaign did not run posterior/evidence inference.
claims.experiment_implication: Prioritize same-likelihood baseline comparisons, boundary sensitivity and null-mock selection calibration; preserve the published parameter/statistic definitions.

claims.statement: DES-Dovekie is an updated calibration/reanalysis of the DES supernova program, not an independent sample to multiply by the original DES-SN5YR likelihood; the local screen profiles one magnitude offset and cannot infer H0.
claims.status: full-text and pinned-release supported; independent profile reproduction

primary_evidence.locator: Calibration discussion; sample comparison; Tables 10-11.
Pinned commit c9a4fcafc4cbd19bd750dee47fc76194a45c181f, release README and paired likelihood files.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The official module requests CSV while the pinned data file contains whitespace SNANA records; our native-format implementations follow documented semantics but do not execute the complete released CosmoSIS pipeline or reproduce its posterior.
claims.experiment_implication: Use one SN branch at a time, keep full STAT+SYS precision and row order, and document overlap before combining with other SN compilations.

claims.statement: DESI DR2 Ly-alpha full-shape/AP Results IV and the earlier Ly-alpha BAO Results I share the DR2 sample family; updated combinations replace/recondition the older Ly-alpha representation rather than adding it as an independent likelihood factor.
claims.status: full-text-supported; public joint likelihood locator incomplete
claims.confidence: high for sample overlap; moderate for an external combination recipe

primary_evidence.locator: Eqs. (24)-(26), Sec. VI and Data Availability.
Full arXiv HTML read, v3; earlier compressed measurement from the DR2 Ly-alpha sample family.
Full arXiv HTML read, v2; companion mock/data-split checks, not independent observations.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: An exact public joint covariance/likelihood for the updated full-shape product was not located in the literature pass; the local 13-point BAO vector still includes the earlier Ly-alpha rows.
claims.experiment_implication: Do not multiply Results IV constraints by the old Ly-alpha BAO entries; require and audit the released replacement/joint likelihood first.

claims.statement: ACT full spectra, ACT-lite and P-ACT are alternative likelihood products/combinations, not independent factors; P-ACT applies Planck overlap cuts and other DR2 CMB bundles may already include ACT/Planck lensing.

primary_evidence.locator: NASA LAMBDA DR6.02 likelihood/product inventory.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: Official collaboration products can define valid combinations under their documented cuts; dependence must be assessed from the chosen product, not assumed universally absent.
claims.experiment_implication: Before any CMB extension, name every constituent spectrum/lensing likelihood and avoid multiplying a joint posterior by its components.

claims.statement: For prescribed density, constant K and positive u=exp(-K phi), the printed thermodynamic-gravity evolution equation transforms exactly to u_t=D[laplacian(u)+4 pi G K rho u]; its stationary fixed-source equation is linear in u.
claims.status: full-text equation check and independent algebra/synthetic reproduction; not a novelty claim
claims.confidence: high for the chain-rule identity; conditional physical interpretation

primary_evidence.locator: Printed Eq. (1), p. 2, visually checked in user-provided journal PDF.
Eqs. (2), (5)-(8), pp. 3-4; source/sign conventions.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The transform alone proves neither positivity/stability nor boundary-condition equivalence, coupled matter evolution or observational success; use the Poisson limit directly at K=0.
claims.experiment_implication: A meaningful next theory test needs transformed boundary conditions, positivity and near-singular/domain-convergence checks before predictive data fitting.

claims.statement: The supplied paper's NGC 3198 comparison is a conditional spherical surrogate fit, not an isolated-boundary or whole-galaxy holdout prediction, because observed endpoint velocities enter derivative boundary conditions.
claims.status: full-text-supported method assessment; not an independent numerical refit
claims.confidence: high for the stated boundary prescription; low for any broader theory verdict

primary_evidence.locator: Finite-difference scheme Eqs. (34)-(42), pp. 7-8, including observed endpoint velocities in Eqs. (41)-(42).
Sec. 3.2, pp. 8-9; conditional NGC 3198 proof-of-concept description.
Secs. 2 and 5; disk geometry and baryonic-mass-model limitations.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The present campaign did not reconstruct a unique 3D baryon density, implement an exterior boundary at infinity, or rerun the paper's galaxy fit.
claims.experiment_implication: Report only conditional reproduction unless a source geometry and outer physical boundary independent of held-out observed velocities are specified.

claims.statement: For the campaign's tested DESI DR2 BAO profile optima, a standard-reference massless-radiation term tied to H0 over 50-90 km/s/Mpc shifts predictions by less than 0.075 marginal sigma and less than 0.128 in the full-covariance displacement norm; this supports radiation omission only for this stated screen and tested optima.
claims.confidence: moderate within the explicitly tested massless-radiation reference; not a bound over the full parameter domain

primary_evidence.locator: Printed pp. 4-5, Eqs. (4)-(10), including flat distance and separate photon/neutrino background terms.
Table XXXII; SI constants used for the photon/radiation density.
Reported CMB temperature 2.72548 +/- 0.00057 K; calculation uses rounded 2.7255 K.
Note 4; exact AU/parsec conversion in H100 unit conversion.
Eq. (26.1), effective relativistic density normalization; not a massive-neutrino evolution model.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The reference treats neutrinos as massless radiation, unlike the DESI massive-neutrino background; H0 values form a declared sensitivity grid, not posterior support; the whole shape box and higher redshift are not exhaustively bounded.
claims.experiment_implication: Use a consistent physical massive-neutrino model for any precision inference or for claims outside the tested best-fit points and H0 grid.
